cohort: 110 women with class III obesity (body mass index ≥40 kg/m(2)) undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: The trial was stopped early due to slow enrollment and findings from larger trials; however, the use of prophylactic negative-pressure wound therapy devices for cesarean delivery did not significantly reduce wound complications compared to standard surgical dressings in this cohort.
mod_finding: This study examined the use of negative-pressure wound therapy in patients with class III obesity undergoing cesarean delivery and found no reduction in wound complications compared to standard surgical dressing.
